purpose: Independent negative review probes; violations are defects, not passing safety tests.
scope: Temporary fixture stores and local fixture child processes only; no application, service, scheduled task, production store or real provider used.
head: c60618987150c3514509a9d17ffacf0f0890cc36

results.invariant: Runtime identifiers alone must not authenticate a connection or authorize permit admission.
Revoking a host policy must stop an active run admitted under it.
results.expected: active run canceled, included in Stop scope

results.invariant: The host status CLI must not recover or mutate an independently running host.
Lifecycle must enforce the consented profile, build root and application mode before stopping or launching.
results.expected: blocked without stopping the controlling application or launching another profile

results.invariant: A launch registration nonce must be consumed once and cannot replace a verified runtime generation by replay.
results.expected: replay refused or reconciled to the original registration receipt

results.invariant: The shared providerInvocations limit must bound actual role invocations, not only the number of runs.
results.expected: at most one provider invocation under a limit of one

results.invariant: An exact retry after a lost createRun reply must reconcile to the committed run receipt.
results.expected: the same committed run receipt without another admission or charge

observed.retryMessage: The Local Control Host refused admission: permit_settled.

results.invariant: Policy expiry must stop active owned work and must not let its run complete successfully.
results.expected: active run stopped at the host deadline

results.invariant: An ambiguous launcher failure must block another restart until the first launch is reconciled.
results.expected: one ambiguous effect, a reconciling/blocked outcome and no second launch
